subject: english
stem: The class website stopped showing pictures after an update. Eva found that the image folder had been renamed and restored its old name; the pictures returned. What is the best causal summary?
options: Renaming the image folder back fixed the missing pictures.
The website had many beautiful pictures.
Eva updated every computer in town.
Folders are always harmful to websites.

optionRationales.reason: Renaming the image folder back fixed the missing pictures.：明確連結原因修正與結果。
The website had many beautiful pictures.：未提美感且缺問題解決。
Eva updated every computer in town.：過度。
Folders are always harmful to websites.：錯誤概括。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「摘要保留初始目標或問題、關鍵因果轉折與結果，刪除不影響因果鏈的細節」可推出 Renaming the image folder back fixed the missing pictures.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Renaming the image folder back fixed the missing pictures. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
